title: Compliance Analyst & OpEx II
description:
TITLE:  Compliance Analyst & OpEx II
TYPE:  Contract
LOCATION:  Norristown, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID:  Hybrid, onsite 1 day a week
START DATE:  October 2025
SHIFT:  Monday – Friday, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm


We are looking for a Compliance Analyst & OpEx contractor. The Operational Excellence department oversees the organization's OpEx and Internal Controls programs. The successful candidate will be a strong communicator, both written and verbal, able to share information clearly across teams and stakeholders. They should bring excellent organizational skills to manage competing priorities, while maintaining a strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and consistency in all deliverables.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Provide support and coordination for program initiatives such as training, event analysis, and metrics/data management.
  • Administer and test the event analysis and action-tracking tool.
  • Develop, update, and maintain program and process documentation.
  • Assist in preparing communication plans, status reports, and metrics tracking.
  • Contribute independently and in teams to projects involving process documentation, coordination, and improvement initiatives.
  • Use analytical skills to identify problems, collect and interpret data, and recommend solutions.
  • Present findings effectively to peers, management, stakeholders, and external groups.
 
QUALIFICATIONS
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in business analysis, project management/coordination, or related work
  • Strong customer service mindset with excellent interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on producing accurate, high-quality work
  • Proven time management and organizational abilities
  • Ability to collaborate in team settings and communicate effectively
  • Experience with both quantitative and qualitative analysis
Preferred Qualifications:
  • 3+ years of experience in the electric utility industry, human performance, event analysis, or internal controls
  • Experience working with committees, stakeholder groups, or governance forums
  • Direct experience conducting event analysis
  • Familiarity with compliance tools, business processes, and internal systems
  • Understanding of regulatory and governance frameworks in the energy/utility field
  • Knowledge of operations, markets, planning, or IT systems within the utility or energy sector
  • Background in developing or documenting internal controls
 
 
EOE STATEMENT

We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, political affiliation, union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Business/Sr Business Analyst
description:
TITLE:  Business/Sr Business Analyst
TYPE:  Contract
LOCATION:  Norristown, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Hybrid or Remote  
START DATE:  October 2025
SHIFT:  Monday – Friday, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm


We are looking for a Business/Sr Business Analyst. This role provides project documentation and business analysis support across multiple initiatives. The analyst will partner with business users to capture current (As-Is) and future (To-Be) processes, define requirements, identify application dependencies, and recommend process improvements. The role also involves creating detailed documentation, process flows, and supporting change management activities.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Analyze existing systems, processes, and dependencies; prepare clear documentation of current state and proposed future state use cases.
  • Develop, update, and maintain process flows, business rules, and supporting diagrams using Visio or similar tools.
  • Serve as a primary liaison between clients, project managers, and technical teams to ensure shared understanding of business needs and system interactions.
  • Support project managers by providing insights into user experience, business impacts, and process design considerations.
  • Monitor project backlogs, assist in prioritization, and ensure tasks are completed on schedule.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive business analysis deliverables including requirements documents, traceability matrices, data dictionaries, meeting notes, and training materials.
  • Jump in to support the team with ad-hoc tasks and deliverables when needed to meet deadlines.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering sessions, capturing and documenting detailed business, functional, and technical requirements.
  • Provide timely updates and progress reports to project managers and stakeholders.
  • Track, manage, and resolve change requests from initiation through completion, ensuring proper follow-up and closure.
  • Partner with business clients to develop requirements for new use cases and enhancements.
  • Document and track recurring issues in business systems or processes, recommending long-term efficiency improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure requirements are fully understood and correctly implemented.
 
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business Administration, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Prior experience with third-party software implementations.
  • Demonstrated experience in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
  • Experience producing core BA deliverables (e.g., requirements documents, As-Is and To-Be diagrams, use cases, traceability matrix, data dictionary, business rules, meeting notes).
  • Proven ability to drive tasks to completion with minimal supervision.
  • Strong background in requirements gathering, process design, and documentation.
  • Proficiency with process mapping tools such as Visio (or similar).
  • Skilled in managing multiple priorities within matrixed, cross-functional project teams.
  • Positive, energetic, and solutions-focused mindset with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical groups.
  • Knowledge of documentation best practices, including version control and requirement tracking.
Preferred Qualifications
  • IIBA certification.
  • Hands-on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Exposure to data inputs/outputs in Market Risk systems.
  • Familiarity with reporting requirements and tools such as Tableau or Alteryx.
 
EOE STATEMENT
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, political affiliation, union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Construction Project Estimator
description:
TITLE: Construction Project Estimator
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Chalfont, PA (Company will be moving to Fort Washington)
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Onsite

We are looking for a Construction Project Estimator to lead and oversee all preconstruction activities from project conception through construction award. Industries we serve are life science, pharma, food and beverage, animal health, aerospace, etc. Experience outside of these industries will be considered.

This role is responsible for shaping project scope, establishing budgets, and developing schedules, while serving as a key liaison between clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams. The Project Estimator ensures projects are strategically planned, competitively priced, and positioned for successful execution in alignment with quality, safety, and profitability standards.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development of project budgets, schedules, and scopes during preconstruction, ensuring accuracy and alignment with client objectives.
  • Collaborate with design teams, manufacturing, field operations, subcontractors, and vendors to define requirements, secure resources, and ensure all scopes are properly accounted for.
  • Provide strategic input on project design concepts, execution strategies, submittals, and billings to set the foundation for successful delivery.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain procedures for cost control, scope management, billing and collections, change management, and project reporting.
  • Uphold company standards, ethics, and a culture of safety and quality throughout all phases of preconstruction.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by serving as the primary point of contact throughout preconstruction, ensuring satisfaction and positioning for repeat opportunities.
  • Oversee subcontractor/vendor relationships, including prequalification, bidding, and negotiation of scopes to ensure value and compliance with project goals.
  • Identify potential risks and lead efforts to resolve issues or disputes through proactive problem-solving and compromise.
  • Direct the smooth transition of projects from sales through preconstruction to operations, ensuring all scopes, budgets, and strategies are clearly communicated and executed.
  • Prepare, track, and analyze project performance metrics, including profitability, budget adherence, and competitive benchmarking.
  • Participate in pre-sale and post-award client presentations, contributing expertise to strengthen proposals and client confidence.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–8 years of experience in construction, estimating, and project development.
  • Degree in engineering, architecture, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong technical knowledge of building systems, construction methods, and project workflows.
  • Proven ability to develop accurate budgets, schedules, and execution strategies.
  • Experience leading risk management, cost history tracking, and change order resolution.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage subcontractor/vendor negotiations and maintain strong external partnerships.
  • Excellent client-facing skills, with a track record of building long-term relationships.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.

EOE STATEMENT
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, political affiliation, union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: IT Project Manager
description:
TITLE: IT Project Manager
TYPE: Contract to Hire
LOCATION: Horsham, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Hybrid, onsite 3 days a week
START DATE: October 2025


We are looking for an IT Project Manager. The IT Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and completing technology projects on time and within budget. This includes defining project objectives, coordinating resources, managing vendors, and ensuring quality throughout the project lifecycle. The role requires strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills to oversee deliverables, manage risks, and align project outcomes with business goals. The IT Project Manager also supports continuous improvement by leveraging modern tools and practices to optimize delivery, collaboration, and reporting.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead medium-to-large scale IT projects, including customer-facing web applications integrated with enterprise systems.
  • Define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and costs; adjust forecasts as needed and secure approval for changes.
  • Identify dependencies, monitor critical paths, and proactively manage risks, issues, and scope changes.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to build business cases and track benefits realization.
  • Establish project success criteria and ensure alignment across stakeholders.
  • Conduct retrospectives to identify lessons learned and recommend improvements.
  • Manage all aspects of the project lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure.
  • Apply best practices, tools, and frameworks (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) to ensure effective project execution.
  • Utilize modern delivery tools—including automation, Generative AI, Azure DevOps, Adobe Workfront—to enhance efficiency, risk management, and reporting.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with project stakeholders, vendors, and third-party partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication.
  • Represent project interests to senior leadership and provide regular updates on progress and challenges.
  • Deliver detailed project plans, progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and executive presentations.
  • Track supplier performance in areas such as information security, customer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Promote a collaborative team culture that values transparency, adaptability, and continuous learning.
  • Set performance expectations, monitor progress, and provide feedback throughout the project cycle.
  • Ensure adherence to corporate and PMO standards.
  • Oversee contract performance against KPIs and identify areas for improvement.
  • Manage deliverables outlined in statements of work (SOWs).
  • Negotiate contracts, track compliance, and escalate performance issues when necessary.
  • Coach, mentor, and guide project team members and contractors, fostering accountability and skill development.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure contracts support business and project needs.
  • Review business cases to recommend appropriate procurement strategies.
  • Research suppliers, monitor market conditions, and maintain commercial awareness.
  • Support tendering, procurement, and vendor negotiations, ensuring processes meet compliance standards.

QUALIFICATIONS
Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Science or Arts.
  • 3+ years of experience managing and leading IT projects.
  • 3+ years of experience with SDLC, PMLC, and multiple methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).
  • Proven success managing medium to large IT projects, including enterprise applications, cloud, and infrastructure initiatives.
  • Customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Project, Excel, Word, Visio) and collaboration tools such as SharePoint or project management platforms.
  • Strong collaboration, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Experience delivering large-scale, customer-facing web applications integrated with enterprise systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and within collaborative teams.
  • Experience managing shifting priorities and high-pressure environments with efficiency.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and motivate.
Preferred
  • PMP certification (in good standing).
  • Proficiency with modern delivery tools, including Generative AI, Adobe Workfront, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
  • Agile certification (CSM or equivalent).
  • Experience in the building or construction industry.

EOE STATEMENT
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, political affiliation, union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law.
